title: AS2 compiler: hoist class field initializers into the constructor so they run for class-linked placed instances (Flash 8 fidelity)
description: AS2 fidelity bug: class member field initializers (e.g. private var vy:Number = 0 inside a ClassDecl) do NOT run for instances created when a MovieClip symbol is linked to the class via className linkage and placed on stage — fields are undefined at runtime (cascading to NaN). In real Flash 8 the compiler hoists member initializers into the class constructor, so they always run. EXPLORE packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts compileClassDecl (~2909) + how member VarDecls with initializers are currently emitted (prototype assignment? dropped? a synthesized init that this path skips?) and how the constructor is emitted/synthesized. FIX: compile class member field initializers as assignments executed in the CONSTRUCTOR body (synthesize a constructor if the class has none; if a user constructor exists, run the field initializers at the start of it, before the user body — confirm/match Flash 8 ordering), so they run for ALL instances including className-linked placed symbols. Keep static members + methods on the prototype as today; only instance field initializers move into the constructor. ACCEPTANCE = Ruffle e2e (per CLAUDE.md, byte tests insufficient): a class with field initializers (e.g. var n:Number = 7), linked to a library MovieClip via className, placed on stage, traces the INITIALIZED value at runtime (7, not undefined/NaN) — both with NO explicit constructor and WITH an explicit constructor (initializers + constructor body both applied). VERIFY: build + core/swf tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixtures acceptable); existing AS2 class tests (as2-class-attach/capstone) still pass; new e2e passes. Update docs/ + CLAUDE.md (note initializers now work). ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry (if .tasks/.counter conflicts keep origin's). Scope: as2/compiler.ts (+ parser if needed) + tests + e2e. Coordinate: a sibling task updates AS2 guidance text in systemPrompt/CLAUDE — different files, no conflict.
